title: Shipyard prep file
description: The one file the prep run returns: the level, the group of each PR, the release notes and the report's words. docs/prep-file.md explains each field.

level.description: The level of the release, why, and an answer for each read-first flag in the facts.

bump.description: The semver level of the release.

reasons.description: Why this level, one sentence each.

flags.description: An answer for each read-first flag in the facts.

flag.description: The id of the flag, as the facts name it.

answer.description: What the prep run found, and what it means for the level.

groups.description: The group of each PR in the range: every PR in exactly one group. A group with no PRs may be left out.

notes.description: The release notes, for users: public text with no internal term, private link or file path.

title.description: The title of the release notes.

summary.description: One sentence of 140 characters or fewer.

text.description: The item, as users read it.

covers.description: The PRs in the range this item is about.

report.description: The report's words. The approver's part (each change with its before and after, safety, the risks and the internal lines) tops the release PR; the proof, what was not tested and the notes for the release manager are folded below it. Together they are 300 words or fewer.

summary.description: What this release is, in a sentence or two. It heads the folded proof.

changes.description: What changes for users: a short name for each change, what a person had before and has after it, what proves it, and the PRs it is about.

change.description: A short name for the change, a few words: its heading in the approver's part.

before.description: What a person saw or had before this release, in plain words.

after.description: What a person sees or has after it, in plain words.

proof.description: What proves the change: a test by name, a check that ran, a number. Folded below the approver's part.

covers.description: The PRs in the range this change is about. The release PR shows them beside the change; a PR a user can see that no change covers gets a row that says no proof was given.

safety.description: Could this release break something? The answer for the approver: no and why not, or what to watch.

risks.description: Each risk to users or production, and what we do if it happens. A note about running the release goes in managerNotes.

internal.description: A plain line for each change users do not see, and the PRs it is about. Every PR grouped Internal is in some line's covers.

text.description: The change in a few plain words, never the PR's title.

covers.description: The PRs in the range this line is about.

managerNotes.description: Notes for the person running the release (a paused run to approve, a step to run again), folded under For the release manager.

text.description: Text with at least one character that is not a space.
